 282:     private async void CreatePdfSheet_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
 283:     {
 284:         if (_placements.Count == 0)
 285:         {
 286:             MessageBox.Show(this, "Add at least one detail to the sheet.", "Standard Details - Create PDF Sheet", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
 287:             return;
 288:         }
 289: 
 290:         ToggleBusy(true);
 291:         try
 292:         {
 293:             SummaryText.Text = "Building personal PDF sheet...";
 294:             var placements = new System.Collections.Generic.List<CustomSheetPlacementSpec>();
 295:             var missing = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
 296:             foreach (var row in _placements)
 297:             {
 298:                 var center = ReadPlacementCenter(row);
 299:                 var size = ComputePlacementSizeMm(row);
 300:                 var detailPdf = await _catalogRepository.LoadRenderedPdfAsync("detail", row.DetailNumber);
 301:                 if (detailPdf is not { Length: > 0 })
 302:                 {
 303:                     detailPdf = null;
 304:                     missing.Add(row.DetailNumber);
 305:                 }
 306: 
 307:                 placements.Add(new CustomSheetPlacementSpec(
 308:                     row.DetailNumber,
 309:                     detailPdf,
 310:                     center.X - (size.Width / 2),
 311:                     center.Y - (size.Height / 2),
 312:                     size.Width,
 313:                     size.Height));
 314:             }
 315: 
 316:             if (missing.Count > 0 && !ConfirmMissingCustomPdfArt(missing))
 317:             {
 318:                 SummaryText.Text = "Personal PDF sheet cancelled.";
 319:                 return;
 320:             }
 321: 
 322:             var generatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
 323:             var spec = new CustomSheetSpec(
 324:                 SheetWidthMm,
 325:                 SheetHeightMm,
 326:                 SheetNumberBox.Text.Trim(),
 327:                 SheetNameBox.Text.Trim(),
 328:                 Environment.UserName,
 329:                 generatedUtc,
 330:                 placements);
 331: 
 332:             var bytes = CustomPdfSheetComposer.Build(spec);
 333:             var path = PromptForCustomSheetPath(generatedUtc);
 334:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
 335:             {
 336:                 SummaryText.Text = "Personal PDF sheet cancelled.";
 337:                 return;
 338:             }
 339: 
 340:             await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(path, bytes);
 341:             try
 342:             {
 343:                 Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(path) { UseShellExecute = true });
 344:                 SummaryText.Text = $"Created personal PDF sheet: {path}";
 345:             }
 346:             catch (Exception openEx)
 347:             {
 348:                 SummaryText.Text = $"Created personal PDF sheet: {path}";
 349:                 MessageBox.Show(
 350:                     this,
 351:                     $"The PDF was saved at:{Environment.NewLine}{path}{Environment.NewLine}{Environment.NewLine}It could not be opened automatically:{Environment.NewLine}{openEx.Message}",
 352:                     "Standard Details - Create PDF Sheet",
 353:                     MessageBoxButton.OK,
 354:                     MessageBoxImage.Warning);
 355:             }
 356:         }
 357:         catch (Exception ex)
 358:         {
 359:             SummaryText.Text = "Personal PDF sheet could not be created.";
 360:             MessageBox.Show(this, ex.Message, "Standard Details - Create PDF Sheet Failed", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
 361:         }
 362:         finally
 363:         {
 364:             ToggleBusy(false);
 365:         }
 366:     }

 368:     private static SheetComposerPlacement ToPlacement(ComposerPlacementDisplayRow row)
 369:     {
 370:         if (!double.TryParse(row.XmmText, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var x))
 371:         {
 372:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"{row.DetailNumber}: X mm must be a number.");
 373:         }
 374: 
 375:         if (!double.TryParse(row.YmmText, NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var y))
 376:         {
 377:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"{row.DetailNumber}: Y mm must be a number.");
 378:         }
 379: 
 380:         int? scale = null;
 381:         var scaleText = row.ScaleText?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
 382:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(scaleText))
 383:         {
 384:             if (!int.TryParse(scaleText, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var parsed) || parsed < 1 || parsed > 24000)
 385:             {
 386:                 throw new InvalidOperationException($"{row.DetailNumber}: Scale must be blank or an integer from 1 to 24000.");
 387:             }
 388: 
 389:             scale = parsed;
 390:         }
 391: 
 392:         return new SheetComposerPlacement(row.DetailNumber, row.CanonicalViewName, x, y, scale);
 393:     }
 394: 
 395:     private bool ConfirmMissingCustomPdfArt(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<string> missing)
 396:     {
 397:         var shown = missing.Take(20).ToList();
 398:         var message = "These details have no captured art and will appear as labelled placeholders:"
 399:                       + Environment.NewLine
 400:                       + string.Join(Environment.NewLine, shown.Select(x => $"- {x}"));
 401:         if (missing.Count > shown.Count)
 402:         {
 403:             message += Environment.NewLine + $"- ... {missing.Count - shown.Count} more";
 404:         }
 405: 
 406:         message += Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine + "Continue?";
 407:         return MessageBox.Show(this, message, "Standard Details - Missing PDF Art", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Warning) == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
 408:     }

 410:     private string? PromptForCustomSheetPath(DateTime generatedUtc)
 411:     {
 412:         var sheetNumber = SheetNumberBox.Text.Trim();
 413:         var fallback = $"KOR-Custom-Sheet-{generatedUtc:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}";
 414:         var fileName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sheetNumber)
 415:             ? $"{fallback}.pdf"
 416:             : $"{SanitizeFileName(sheetNumber)}.pdf";
 417:         var documents = Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.MyDocuments);
 418:         var dialog = new SaveFileDialog
 419:         {
 420:             Filter = "PDF|*.pdf",
 421:             DefaultExt = ".pdf",
 422:             AddExtension = true,
 423:             OverwritePrompt = true,
 424:             FileName = fileName,
 425:             InitialDirectory = Directory.Exists(documents) ? documents : string.Empty
 426:         };
 427: 
 428:         return dialog.ShowDialog(this) == true ? dialog.FileName : null;
 429:     }

 444:     private void PlacementThumb_DragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
 445:     {
 446:         if (sender is not FrameworkElement { DataContext: ComposerPlacementDisplayRow row })
 447:         {
 448:             return;
 449:         }
 450: 
 451:         var center = ReadPlacementCenter(row);
 452:         var size = ComputePlacementSizeMm(row);
 453:         var x = center.X + PixelsToMm(e.HorizontalChange);
 454:         var y = center.Y + PixelsToMm(e.VerticalChange);
 455:         if (SnapCheckBox.IsChecked == true)
 456:         {
 457:             x = Snap(x);
 458:             y = Snap(y);
 459:         }
 460: 
 461:         x = Clamp(x, size.Width / 2, SheetWidthMm - (size.Width / 2));
 462:         y = Clamp(y, size.Height / 2, SheetHeightMm - (size.Height / 2));
 463:         SetPlacementCenter(row, x, y, updateText: true);
 464:     }
 465: 
 466:     private void ResizeThumb_DragDelta(object sender, DragDeltaEventArgs e)
 467:     {
 468:         if (sender is not FrameworkElement { DataContext: ComposerPlacementDisplayRow row })
 469:         {
 470:             return;
 471:         }
 472: 
 473:         e.Handled = true;
 474:         PlacementsGrid.SelectedItem = row;
 475: 
 476:         var size = ComputePlacementSizeMm(row);
 477:         var verticalWidthDelta = PixelsToMm(e.VerticalChange) * row.ImageAspect;
 478:         var horizontalWidthDelta = PixelsToMm(e.HorizontalChange);
 479:         var widthDelta = Math.Abs(verticalWidthDelta) > Math.Abs(horizontalWidthDelta)
 480:             ? verticalWidthDelta
 481:             : horizontalWidthDelta;
 482:         var width = Clamp(size.Width + widthDelta, MinPlacementWidthMm, MaxPlacementWidthMm);
 483:         var scale = ClampInt((int)Math.Round(DefaultPlacementWidthMm * 100 / width), 1, 24000);
 484:         var center = ReadPlacementCenter(row);
 485: 
 486:         _syncingPlacementFields = true;
 487:         try
 488:         {
 489:             row.ScaleText = scale.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
 490:             SetPlacementCenter(row, center.X, center.Y, updateText: true);
 491:         }
 492:         finally
 493:         {
 494:             _syncingPlacementFields = false;
 495:         }
 496: 
 497:         UpdatePlacementFromFields(row);
 498:     }

 500:     private async Task<BitmapSource?> LoadDetailThumbnailAsync(string detailNumber)
 501:     {
 502:         byte[]? bytes;
 503:         try
 504:         {
 505:             bytes = await _catalogRepository.LoadRenderedImageAsync("detail", detailNumber);
 506:         }
 507:         catch
 508:         {
 509:             return null;
 510:         }
 511: 
 512:         if (bytes is not { Length: > 0 })
 513:         {
 514:             return null;
 515:         }
 516: 
 517:         try
 518:         {
 519:             var bmp = new BitmapImage();
 520:             using (var ms = new MemoryStream(bytes))
 521:             {
 522:                 bmp.BeginInit();
 523:                 bmp.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
 524:                 bmp.StreamSource = ms;
 525:                 bmp.EndInit();
 526:             }
 527: 
 528:             bmp.Freeze();
 529:             return bmp;
 530:         }
 531:         catch
 532:         {
 533:             return null;
 534:         }
 535:     }

 574:     private void UpdateSheetCanvas()
 575:     {
 576:         var availableWidth = Math.Max(1, SheetHost.ActualWidth - 4);
 577:         var availableHeight = Math.Max(1, SheetHost.ActualHeight - 4);
 578:         _sheetPxPerMm = Math.Min(availableWidth / SheetWidthMm, availableHeight / SheetHeightMm);
 579: 
 580:         var width = SheetWidthMm * _sheetPxPerMm;
 581:         var height = SheetHeightMm * _sheetPxPerMm;
 582:         SheetCanvas.Width = width;
 583:         SheetCanvas.Height = height;
 584:         PlacementItems.Width = width;
 585:         PlacementItems.Height = height;
 586: 
 587:         SheetPaper.Width = width;
 588:         SheetPaper.Height = height;
 589:         Canvas.SetLeft(SheetPaper, 0);
 590:         Canvas.SetTop(SheetPaper, 0);
 591: 
 592:         var titleWidth = MmToPixels(TitleBlockWidthMm);
 593:         TitleBlockRegion.Width = titleWidth;
 594:         TitleBlockRegion.Height = height;
 595:         Canvas.SetLeft(TitleBlockRegion, width - titleWidth);
 596:         Canvas.SetTop(TitleBlockRegion, 0);
 597: 
 598:         PositionTitleBlockLine(TitleBlockTopLine, width - titleWidth, height * 0.68, width, height * 0.68);
 599:         PositionTitleBlockLine(TitleBlockMiddleLine, width - titleWidth, height * 0.78, width, height * 0.78);
 600:         PositionTitleBlockLine(TitleBlockBottomLine, width - titleWidth, height * 0.9, width, height * 0.9);
 601: 
 602:         foreach (var row in _placements)
 603:         {
 604:             UpdatePlacementFromFields(row);
 605:         }
 606:     }
 607: 
 608:     private static void PositionTitleBlockLine(System.Windows.Shapes.Line line, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2)
 609:     {
 610:         line.X1 = x1;
 611:         line.Y1 = y1;
 612:         line.X2 = x2;
 613:         line.Y2 = y2;
 614:     }
 615: 
 616:     private void UpdatePlacementFromFields(ComposerPlacementDisplayRow row)
 617:     {
 618:         var center = ReadPlacementCenter(row);
 619:         var size = ComputePlacementSizeMm(row);
 620:         var x = Clamp(center.X, size.Width / 2, SheetWidthMm - (size.Width / 2));
 621:         var y = Clamp(center.Y, size.Height / 2, SheetHeightMm - (size.Height / 2));
 622:         SetPlacementCenter(row, x, y, updateText: x != center.X || y != center.Y);
 623:     }
 624: 
 625:     private (double X, double Y) ReadPlacementCenter(ComposerPlacementDisplayRow row)
 626:     {
 627:         var x = TryParseDouble(row.XmmText, out var parsedX) ? parsedX : SheetWidthMm / 2;
 628:         var y = TryParseDouble(row.YmmText, out var parsedY) ? parsedY : SheetHeightMm / 2;
 629:         return (x, y);
 630:     }
 631: 
 632:     private void SetPlacementCenter(ComposerPlacementDisplayRow row, double xMm, double yMm, bool updateText)
 633:     {
 634:         var size = ComputePlacementSizeMm(row);
 635:         xMm = Clamp(xMm, size.Width / 2, SheetWidthMm - (size.Width / 2));
 636:         yMm = Clamp(yMm, size.Height / 2, SheetHeightMm - (size.Height / 2));
 637: 
 638:         _syncingPlacementFields = true;
 639:         try
 640:         {
 641:             if (updateText)
 642:             {
 643:                 row.XmmText = FormatMm(xMm);
 644:                 row.YmmText = FormatMm(yMm);
 645:             }
 646: 
 647:             row.SetCanvasRect(
 648:                 MmToPixels(xMm - (size.Width / 2)),
 649:                 MmToPixels(yMm - (size.Height / 2)),
 650:                 MmToPixels(size.Width),
 651:                 MmToPixels(size.Height));
 652:         }
 653:         finally
 654:         {
 655:             _syncingPlacementFields = false;
 656:         }
 657:     }
 658: 
 659:     private (double Width, double Height) ComputePlacementSizeMm(ComposerPlacementDisplayRow row)
 660:     {
 661:         var scale = TryParseScale(row.ScaleText) ?? 100;
 662:         var width = Clamp(DefaultPlacementWidthMm * 100 / scale, MinPlacementWidthMm, MaxPlacementWidthMm);
 663:         var height = width / Math.Max(0.2, row.ImageAspect);
 664:         if (height > SheetHeightMm * 0.9)
 665:         {
 666:             height = SheetHeightMm * 0.9;
 667:             width = height * row.ImageAspect;
 668:         }
 669: 
 670:         return (width, height);
 671:     }
 672: 
 673:     private (double X, double Y) FindFreeSpot(double widthMm, double heightMm)
 674:     {
 675:         var margin = 20;
 676:         var step = 25;
 677:         for (var y = margin + (heightMm / 2); y <= SheetHeightMm - (heightMm / 2); y += step)
 678:         {
 679:             for (var x = margin + (widthMm / 2); x <= SheetWidthMm - TitleBlockWidthMm - (widthMm / 2) - margin; x += step)
 680:             {
 681:                 if (!_placements.Any(p => Overlaps(x, y, widthMm, heightMm, p)))
 682:                 {
 683:                     return (x, y);
 684:                 }
 685:             }
 686:         }
 687: 
 688:         return (SheetWidthMm / 2, SheetHeightMm / 2);
 689:     }
 690: 
 691:     private bool Overlaps(double xMm, double yMm, double widthMm, double heightMm, ComposerPlacementDisplayRow row)
 692:     {
 693:         var center = ReadPlacementCenter(row);
 694:         var size = ComputePlacementSizeMm(row);
 695:         var left = xMm - (widthMm / 2);
 696:         var right = xMm + (widthMm / 2);
 697:         var top = yMm - (heightMm / 2);
 698:         var bottom = yMm + (heightMm / 2);
 699:         var rowLeft = center.X - (size.Width / 2);
 700:         var rowRight = center.X + (size.Width / 2);
 701:         var rowTop = center.Y - (size.Height / 2);
 702:         var rowBottom = center.Y + (size.Height / 2);
 703:         return left < rowRight && right > rowLeft && top < rowBottom && bottom > rowTop;
 704:     }
 705: 
 706:     private double MmToPixels(double mm) => mm * _sheetPxPerMm;
 707: 
 708:     private double PixelsToMm(double pixels) => pixels / Math.Max(0.0001, _sheetPxPerMm);
 709: 
 710:     private static double Snap(double value) => Math.Round(value / SnapGridMm) * SnapGridMm;
 711: 
 712:     private static double Clamp(double value, double min, double max) => Math.Min(Math.Max(value, min), max);
 713: 
 714:     private static int ClampInt(int value, int min, int max) => Math.Min(Math.Max(value, min), max);
 715: 
 716:     private static string FormatMm(double value) => Math.Round(value, 1).ToString("0.#", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
 717: 
 718:     private static string SanitizeFileName(string value)
 719:     {
 720:         var invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars().ToHashSet();
 721:         var cleaned = new string(value.Trim()
 722:             .Select(ch => invalid.Contains(ch) ? '-' : ch)
 723:             .ToArray());
 724:         cleaned = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(cleaned, @"\s+", "-");
 725:         cleaned = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(cleaned, "-{2,}", "-").Trim('-', '.');
 726:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cleaned) ? "KOR-Custom-Sheet" : cleaned;
 727:     }
 728: 
 729:     private static bool TryParseDouble(string text, out double value)
 730:         => double.TryParse(text?.Trim(), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out value);
 731: 
 732:     private static int? TryParseScale(string text)
 733:     {
 734:         return int.TryParse(text?.Trim(), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var value) && value >= 1
 735:             ? value
 736:             : null;
 737:     }
 738: 
 739:     private static SheetComposerOccupiedDetail? FindOccupancy(
 740:         ComposerDetailDisplayRow detail,
 741:         System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SheetComposerOccupiedDetail> occupied)
 742:     {
 743:         if (occupied.TryGetValue(detail.DetailNumber, out var byNumber))
 744:         {
 745:             return byNumber;
 746:         }
 747: 
 748:         return occupied.Values.FirstOrDefault(x => string.Equals(x.ViewName, detail.CanonicalViewName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 749:     }

 784:     private sealed class ComposerPlacementDisplayRow : INotifyPropertyChanged
 785:     {
 786:         private string _xmmText = string.Empty;
 787:         private string _ymmText = string.Empty;
 788:         private string _scaleText = string.Empty;
 789:         private double _canvasLeft;
 790:         private double _canvasTop;
 791:         private double _canvasWidth;
 792:         private double _canvasHeight;
 793: 
 794:         public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;
 795: 
 796:         public string DetailNumber { get; init; } = string.Empty;
 797:         public string Title { get; init; } = string.Empty;
 798:         public string CanonicalViewName { get; init; } = string.Empty;
 799:         public BitmapSource? Thumbnail { get; init; }
 800:         public double ImageAspect { get; init; } = 4.0 / 3.0;
 801:         public Visibility ThumbnailVisibility => Thumbnail is null ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
 802:         public Visibility PlaceholderVisibility => Thumbnail is null ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
 803: 
 804:         public string XmmText
 805:         {
 806:             get => _xmmText;
 807:             set => SetField(ref _xmmText, value ?? string.Empty);
 808:         }
 809: 
 810:         public string YmmText
 811:         {
 812:             get => _ymmText;
 813:             set => SetField(ref _ymmText, value ?? string.Empty);
 814:         }
 815: 
 816:         public string ScaleText
 817:         {
 818:             get => _scaleText;
 819:             set => SetField(ref _scaleText, value ?? string.Empty);
 820:         }
 821: 
 822:         public double CanvasLeft
 823:         {
 824:             get => _canvasLeft;
 825:             private set => SetField(ref _canvasLeft, value);
 826:         }
 827: 
 828:         public double CanvasTop
 829:         {
 830:             get => _canvasTop;
 831:             private set => SetField(ref _canvasTop, value);
 832:         }
 833: 
 834:         public double CanvasWidth
 835:         {
 836:             get => _canvasWidth;
 837:             private set => SetField(ref _canvasWidth, value);
 838:         }
 839: 
 840:         public double CanvasHeight
 841:         {
 842:             get => _canvasHeight;
 843:             private set => SetField(ref _canvasHeight, value);
 844:         }
 845: 
 846:         public void SetCanvasRect(double left, double top, double width, double height)
 847:         {
 848:             CanvasLeft = left;
 849:             CanvasTop = top;
 850:             CanvasWidth = width;
 851:             CanvasHeight = height;
 852:         }
 853: 
 854:         private void SetField<T>(ref T field, T value, [CallerMemberName] string? propertyName = null)
 855:         {
 856:             if (Equals(field, value))

 133:                 name = request.SheetName,
 134:                 like = request.LikeSheet
 135:             }, bridgeTimeout);
 136:             sheetId = await ResolveCreatedSheetIdAsync(sheetReply.Result, request.SheetNumber, bridgeTimeout);
 137: 
 138:             foreach (var placement in request.Placements)
 139:             {
 140:                 await AssertAuthoringActiveAsync($"place {placement.DetailNumber}", bridgeTimeout);
 141:                 if (placement.Scale is { } scale)
 142:                 {
 143:                     var scaleReply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 144:                     {
 145:                         verb = "setscale",
 146:                         view = placement.CanonicalViewName,
 147:                         scale
 148:                     }, bridgeTimeout);
 149: 
 150:                     if (TryGetInt32(scaleReply.Result, "was", out var was)
 151:                         && TryGetString(scaleReply.Result, "view") is { } scaledView
 152:                         && !previousScales.ContainsKey(scaledView))
 153:                     {
 154:                         previousScales.Add(scaledView, was);
 155:                     }
 156:                 }
 157: 
 158:                 var placeReply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 159:                 {
 160:                     verb = "placeview",
 161:                     sheet = request.SheetNumber,
 162:                     view = placement.CanonicalViewName,
 163:                     x_mm = placement.Xmm,
 164:                     y_mm = placement.Ymm
 165:                 }, bridgeTimeout);
 166:                 AssertPlacedCenter(placement, placeReply.Result);
 167:             }
 168: 
 169:             governanceDocumentId = await governanceRepository.CreateDocumentAsync(
 170:                 governanceTitle,
 171:                 BuildGovernanceDescription(request),
 172:                 groupSchemaAvailable,
 173:                 selectedGroupId,
 174:                 actorUserId);
 175: 
 176:             await AssertAuthoringActiveAsync("save composed sheet", bridgeTimeout);
 177:             await _bridge.SendAsync(new { verb = "savedoc" }, bridgeTimeout);
 178: 
 179:             return new SheetComposerResult(request.SheetNumber, request.SheetName, request.Placements.Count, governanceDocumentId);
 180:         }
 181:         catch (Exception ex)
 182:         {
 183:             var rollbackFailures = await RollBackAsync(sheetId, previousScales, bridgeTimeout);
 184:             if (governanceDocumentId is { } documentId)
 185:             {
 186:                 try
 187:                 {
 188:                     await governanceRepository.DeleteRecordAsync(documentId, governanceTitle, actorUserId);
 189:                 }
 190:                 catch (Exception cleanupEx)
 191:                 {
 192:                     rollbackFailures.Add($"governance record {documentId}: {cleanupEx.Message}");
 193:                 }
 194:             }
 195: 
 196:             if (rollbackFailures.Count > 0)
 197:             {
 198:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
 199:                     ex.Message + Environment.NewLine + "Rollback also reported: " + string.Join(" | ", rollbackFailures),
 200:                     ex);
 201:             }
 202: 
 203:             throw;
 204:         }
 205:     }

 207:     internal async Task<string> OpenSheetPdfAsync(string sheetNumber, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 208:     {
 209:         if (!_options.IsConfigured)
 210:         {
 211:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Standard Details sheet-composer settings are incomplete.");
 212:         }
 213: 
 214:         sheetNumber = (sheetNumber ?? "").Trim();
 215:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sheetNumber))
 216:         {
 217:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Sheet number is required before opening a PDF.");
 218:         }
 219: 
 220:         await AssertAuthoringActiveAsync("export sheet PDF", bridgeTimeout);
 221: 
 222:         var exportFolder = Path.Combine(_options.BridgeRoot, "exports", "standard-details-sheets");
 223:         var exportFileName = $"KOR-StandardDetails-{SanitizeFileName(sheetNumber)}-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}";
 224:         Directory.CreateDirectory(exportFolder);
 225: 
 226:         var reply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 227:         {
 228:             verb = "exportsheets",
 229:             folder = exportFolder,
 230:             filename = exportFileName,
 231:             sheets = new[] { sheetNumber }
 232:         }, bridgeTimeout);
 233: 
 234:         var exportedPdf = ResolveExportedSheetPdf(reply.Result, sheetNumber);
 235:         if (!File.Exists(exportedPdf))
 236:         {
 237:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter exported '{sheetNumber}' to '{exportedPdf}', but the app could not read the PDF from that share path.");
 238:         }
 239: 
 240:         return CopyPdfToTempAndOpen(exportedPdf, sheetNumber);
 241:     }

 243:     internal async Task<string> OpenDetailPdfAsync(string detailNumber, KorStandardsReadRepository reader, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 244:     {
 245:         detailNumber = (detailNumber ?? "").Trim();
 246:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(detailNumber))
 247:         {
 248:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Detail number is required before opening a PDF.");
 249:         }
 250: 
 251:         var storedPdf = await reader.LoadRenderedPdfAsync("detail", detailNumber);
 252:         if (storedPdf is { Length: > 0 })
 253:         {
 254:             return CopyPdfBytesToTempAndOpen(storedPdf, detailNumber);
 255:         }
 256: 
 257:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_options.BridgeRoot))
 258:         {
 259:             throw NoCapturedPdf(detailNumber);
 260:         }
 261: 
 262:         var viewElementId = await reader.GetCanonicalViewElementIdAsync(detailNumber);
 263:         if (viewElementId is null)
 264:         {
 265:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"No drawing view is recorded for {detailNumber}; it cannot be exported as a PDF from the catalog.");
 266:         }
 267: 
 268:         try
 269:         {
 270:             await AssertDocumentActiveAsync("export catalog PDF", bridgeTimeout);
 271:         }
 272:         catch (Exception ex) when (IsBridgeUnavailable(ex))
 273:         {
 274:             throw NoCapturedPdf(detailNumber, ex);
 275:         }
 276: 
 277:         var exportFolder = Path.Combine(_options.BridgeRoot, "exports", "standard-details-views");
 278: 
 279:         BridgeReply reply;
 280:         try
 281:         {
 282:             Directory.CreateDirectory(exportFolder);
 283:             reply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 284:             {
 285:                 verb = "exportviews",
 286:                 folder = exportFolder,
 287:                 colors = "color",
 288:                 views = new[] { new { id = viewElementId.Value, key = detailNumber } }
 289:             }, bridgeTimeout);
 290:         }
 291:         catch (Exception ex) when (IsBridgeUnavailable(ex))
 292:         {
 293:             throw NoCapturedPdf(detailNumber, ex);
 294:         }
 295: 
 296:         var exportedPdf = ResolveExportedViewPdf(reply.Result, viewElementId.Value, detailNumber);
 297:         if (!File.Exists(exportedPdf))
 298:         {
 299:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter exported '{detailNumber}' to '{exportedPdf}', but the app could not read the PDF from that share path.");
 300:         }
 301: 
 302:         return CopyPdfToTempAndOpen(exportedPdf, detailNumber);
 303:     }

 305:     private static InvalidOperationException NoCapturedPdf(string detailNumber, Exception? inner = null)
 306:         => new($"No PDF captured for {detailNumber} yet. Publish to capture it, or open Drafter/Revit for a one-time live export.", inner);
 307: 
 308:     private void ValidateRequest(SheetComposerRequest request)
 309:     {
 310:         if (!_options.IsConfigured)
 311:         {
 312:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Standard Details sheet-composer settings are incomplete.");
 313:         }
 314: 
 315:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.SheetNumber))
 316:         {
 317:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Sheet number is required.");
 318:         }
 319: 
 320:         if (request.SheetNumber.Length > SheetNumberMax)
 321:         {
 322:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Sheet number cannot exceed {SheetNumberMax} characters.");
 323:         }
 324: 
 325:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.SheetName))
 326:         {
 327:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Sheet name is required.");
 328:         }
 329: 
 330:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.LikeSheet))
 331:         {
 332:             throw new InvalidOperationException("A title-block source sheet number/name is required.");
 333:         }
 334: 
 335:         if (request.LikeSheet.Length > LikeSheetMax)
 336:         {
 337:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Title-block source sheet cannot exceed {LikeSheetMax} characters.");
 338:         }
 339: 
 340:         if (request.Placements.Count == 0)
 341:         {
 342:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Add at least one detail to the sheet.");
 343:         }
 344: 
 345:         var title = BuildGovernanceTitle(request);
 346:         if (title.Length > GovernanceTitleMax)
 347:         {
 348:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Sheet number and name cannot exceed {GovernanceTitleMax} characters combined.");
 349:         }
 350: 
 351:         var duplicateDetails = request.Placements
 352:             .GroupBy(x => NormalizeDetailNumber(x.DetailNumber), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 353:             .Where(x => x.Count() > 1)
 354:             .Select(x => x.Key)
 355:             .ToList();
 356:         if (duplicateDetails.Count > 0)
 357:         {
 358:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Save refused because the sheet contains duplicate detail selections: " + string.Join(", ", duplicateDetails));
 359:         }
 360: 
 361:         foreach (var placement in request.Placements)
 362:         {
 363:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(placement.DetailNumber) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(placement.CanonicalViewName))
 364:             {
 365:                 throw new InvalidOperationException("Every placement must carry a detail number and canonical view name.");
 366:             }
 367: 
 368:             if (!double.IsFinite(placement.Xmm) || !double.IsFinite(placement.Ymm) || placement.Xmm < 0 || placement.Ymm < 0)
 369:             {
 370:                 throw new InvalidOperationException($"{placement.DetailNumber}: placement coordinates must be finite, non-negative sheet millimetres.");
 371:             }
 372:         }
 373:     }

 375:     private async Task AssertAuthoringActiveAsync(string stage, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 376:     {
 377:         var reply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new { verb = "ping" }, bridgeTimeout);
 378:         var expected = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(_options.AuthoringPath);
 379:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expected)
 380:             && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reply.ActiveDoc)
 381:             && reply.ActiveDoc.Contains(expected, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 382:         {
 383:             return;
 384:         }
 385: 
 386:         var activeDoc = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reply.ActiveDoc) ? "(none)" : reply.ActiveDoc;
 387:         throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter active document is {activeDoc}; expected AUTHORING '{expected}' before {stage}.");
 388:     }

 390:     private async Task AssertDocumentActiveAsync(string stage, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 391:     {
 392:         var reply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new { verb = "ping" }, bridgeTimeout);
 393:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reply.ActiveDoc))
 394:         {
 395:             return;
 396:         }
 397: 
 398:         throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter bridge has no active Revit document before {stage}.");
 399:     }

 401:     private async Task<IReadOnlyList<BridgeSheet>> QuerySheetsAsync(TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 402:     {
 403:         var reply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 404:         {
 405:             verb = "query",
 406:             kind = "sheets"
 407:         }, bridgeTimeout);
 408: 
 409:         var sheets = new List<BridgeSheet>();
 410:         foreach (var item in EnumerateResultItems(reply.Result, "sheets", "items", "results"))
 411:         {
 412:             if (!TryGetInt64(item, "id", out var id))
 413:             {
 414:                 continue;
 415:             }
 416: 
 417:             var views = new List<BridgeSheetView>();
 418:             if (TryGetProperty(item, "views", out var viewArray) && viewArray.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
 419:             {
 420:                 foreach (var view in viewArray.EnumerateArray())
 421:                 {
 422:                     if (TryGetInt64(view, "id", out var viewId))
 423:                     {
 424:                         views.Add(new BridgeSheetView(viewId, TryGetString(view, "name") ?? ""));
 425:                     }
 426:                 }
 427:             }
 428: 
 429:             sheets.Add(new BridgeSheet(
 430:                 id,
 431:                 TryGetString(item, "number") ?? "",
 432:                 TryGetString(item, "name") ?? "",
 433:                 views));
 434:         }
 435: 
 436:         return sheets;
 437:     }

 439:     private async Task<long> ResolveCreatedSheetIdAsync(JsonElement sheetResult, string sheetNumber, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 440:     {
 441:         if (TryGetInt64(sheetResult, "id", out var createdId))
 442:         {
 443:             return createdId;
 444:         }
 445: 
 446:         var sheets = await QuerySheetsAsync(bridgeTimeout);
 447:         var match = sheets.FirstOrDefault(x => string.Equals(x.Number, sheetNumber, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 448:         if (match is not null)
 449:         {
 450:             return match.Id;
 451:         }
 452: 
 453:         throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter created sheet '{sheetNumber}' but did not return a sheet id; rollback cannot be verified.");
 454:     }
 455: 
 456:     private async Task ValidatePlacementViewsAsync(SheetComposerRequest request, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 457:     {
 458:         var views = await QueryViewsAsync(bridgeTimeout);
 459:         var viewNames = views.Select(x => x.Name).ToHashSet(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 460:         var missing = request.Placements
 461:             .Where(x => !viewNames.Contains(x.CanonicalViewName))
 462:             .Select(x => $"{x.DetailNumber} ({x.CanonicalViewName})")
 463:             .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 464:             .ToList();
 465:         if (missing.Count > 0)
 466:         {
 467:             throw new InvalidOperationException("Save refused because these canonical views are not present in active AUTHORING: " + string.Join(", ", missing));
 468:         }
 469:     }

 471:     private async Task<IReadOnlyList<BridgeView>> QueryViewsAsync(TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 472:     {
 473:         var reply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 474:         {
 475:             verb = "query",
 476:             kind = "views"
 477:         }, bridgeTimeout);
 478: 
 479:         var views = new List<BridgeView>();
 480:         foreach (var item in EnumerateResultItems(reply.Result, "views", "items", "results"))
 481:         {
 482:             if (TryGetInt64(item, "id", out var id))
 483:             {
 484:                 views.Add(new BridgeView(id, TryGetString(item, "name") ?? ""));
 485:             }
 486:         }
 487: 
 488:         return views;
 489:     }

 491:     private async Task<List<string>> RollBackAsync(long? sheetId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> previousScales, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 492:     {
 493:         var failures = new List<string>();
 494: 
 495:         foreach (var previousScale in previousScales)
 496:         {
 497:             try
 498:             {
 499:                 await AssertAuthoringActiveAsync($"restore scale for {previousScale.Key}", bridgeTimeout);
 500:                 await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 501:                 {
 502:                     verb = "setscale",
 503:                     view = previousScale.Key,
 504:                     scale = previousScale.Value
 505:                 }, bridgeTimeout);
 506:             }
 507:             catch
 508:             {
 509:                 failures.Add($"scale restore for {previousScale.Key} failed");
 510:             }
 511:         }
 512: 
 513:         if (sheetId is null)
 514:         {
 515:             return failures;
 516:         }
 517: 
 518:         try
 519:         {
 520:             await AssertAuthoringActiveAsync("rollback composed sheet", bridgeTimeout);
 521:             await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 522:             {
 523:                 verb = "delete",
 524:                 ids = new[] { sheetId.Value }
 525:             }, bridgeTimeout);
 526:         }
 527:         catch (Exception ex)
 528:         {
 529:             failures.Add($"sheet delete for id {sheetId.Value} failed: {ex.Message}");
 530:         }
 531: 
 532:         return failures;
 533:     }

 535:     private static string ResolveExportedSheetPdf(JsonElement result, string sheetNumber)
 536:     {
 537:         if (TryGetBool(result, "exists", out var topExists) && !topExists)
 538:         {
 539:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter did not export sheet '{sheetNumber}'.");
 540:         }
 541: 
 542:         if (TryFindSheetExportItem(result, sheetNumber, out var item))
 543:         {
 544:             if (TryGetBool(item, "exists", out var itemExists) && !itemExists)
 545:             {
 546:                 throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter did not export sheet '{sheetNumber}'.");
 547:             }
 548: 
 549:             if (TryGetString(item, "pdf") is { Length: > 0 } itemPdf)
 550:             {
 551:                 return itemPdf;
 552:             }
 553:         }
 554: 
 555:         if (TryGetString(result, "pdf") is { Length: > 0 } pdf)
 556:         {
 557:             return pdf;
 558:         }
 559: 
 560:         throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter export for sheet '{sheetNumber}' did not return a PDF path.");
 561:     }
 562: 
 563:     private static bool TryFindSheetExportItem(JsonElement result, string sheetNumber, out JsonElement item)
 564:     {
 565:         item = default;
 566:         var fallback = default(JsonElement);
 567:         var count = 0;
 568:         foreach (var candidate in EnumerateResultItems(result, "sheets", "items", "results"))
 569:         {
 570:             count++;
 571:             fallback = candidate;
 572:             if (string.Equals(TryGetString(candidate, "number"), sheetNumber, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 573:                 || string.Equals(TryGetString(candidate, "sheet"), sheetNumber, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 574:                 || string.Equals(TryGetString(candidate, "sheetNumber"), sheetNumber, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 575:             {
 576:                 item = candidate;
 577:                 return true;
 578:             }
 579:         }
 580: 
 581:         if (count == 1)
 582:         {
 583:             item = fallback;
 584:             return true;
 585:         }
 586: 
 587:         return false;
 588:     }
 589: 
 590:     private static string ResolveExportedViewPdf(JsonElement result, long viewElementId, string detailNumber)
 591:     {
 592:         if (TryGetBool(result, "exists", out var topExists) && !topExists)
 593:         {
 594:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter did not export view '{detailNumber}'.");
 595:         }
 596: 
 597:         if (TryFindViewExportItem(result, viewElementId, detailNumber, out var item))
 598:         {
 599:             if (TryGetBool(item, "exists", out var itemExists) && !itemExists)
 600:             {
 601:                 throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter did not export view '{detailNumber}'.");
 602:             }
 603: 
 604:             if (TryGetString(item, "pdf") is { Length: > 0 } itemPdf)
 605:             {
 606:                 return itemPdf;
 607:             }
 608:         }
 609: 
 610:         if (TryGetString(result, "pdf") is { Length: > 0 } pdf)
 611:         {
 612:             return pdf;
 613:         }
 614: 
 615:         throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter export for view '{detailNumber}' did not return a PDF path.");
 616:     }
 617: 
 618:     private static bool TryFindViewExportItem(JsonElement result, long viewElementId, string detailNumber, out JsonElement item)
 619:     {
 620:         item = default;
 621:         var fallback = default(JsonElement);
 622:         var count = 0;
 623:         foreach (var candidate in EnumerateResultItems(result, "views", "items", "results"))
 624:         {
 625:             count++;
 626:             fallback = candidate;
 627:             if ((TryGetInt64(candidate, "id", out var id) && id == viewElementId)
 628:                 || string.Equals(TryGetString(candidate, "key"), detailNumber, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 629:                 || string.Equals(TryGetString(candidate, "detailNumber"), detailNumber, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 630:             {
 631:                 item = candidate;
 632:                 return true;
 633:             }
 634:         }
 635: 
 636:         if (count == 1)
 637:         {
 638:             item = fallback;
 639:             return true;
 640:         }
 641: 
 642:         return false;
 643:     }

 645:     private static string CopyPdfToTempAndOpen(string exportedPdf, string identity)
 646:     {
 647:         var tempFolder = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "KOR-StandardDetails");
 648:         Directory.CreateDirectory(tempFolder);
 649:         CleanOldTempPdfs(tempFolder);
 650: 
 651:         var tempPath = Path.Combine(tempFolder, $"{SanitizeFileName(identity)}-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}.pdf");
 652:         File.Copy(exportedPdf, tempPath, overwrite: true);
 653: 
 654:         OpenTempPdf(tempPath);
 655:         return tempPath;
 656:     }
 657: 
 658:     private static string CopyPdfBytesToTempAndOpen(byte[] pdfBytes, string identity)
 659:     {
 660:         var tempFolder = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "KOR-StandardDetails");
 661:         Directory.CreateDirectory(tempFolder);
 662:         CleanOldTempPdfs(tempFolder);
 663: 
 664:         var tempPath = Path.Combine(tempFolder, $"{SanitizeFileName(identity)}-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}.pdf");
 665:         File.WriteAllBytes(tempPath, pdfBytes);
 666:         OpenTempPdf(tempPath);
 667:         return tempPath;
 668:     }
 669: 
 670:     private static void OpenTempPdf(string tempPath)
 671:     {
 672:         Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(tempPath)
 673:         {
 674:             UseShellExecute = true
 675:         });
 676:     }
 677: 
 678:     private static void CleanOldTempPdfs(string tempFolder)
 679:     {
 680:         try
 681:         {
 682:             var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.Subtract(TempPdfRetention);
 683:             foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(tempFolder, "*.pdf", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
 684:             {
 685:                 try
 686:                 {
 687:                     if (File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(file) < cutoff)
 688:                     {
 689:                         File.Delete(file);
 690:                     }
 691:                 }
 692:                 catch
 693:                 {
 694:                     // Best-effort temp cleanup only.
 695:                 }
 696:             }
 697:         }
 698:         catch
 699:         {
 700:             // Best-effort temp cleanup only.
 701:         }
 702:     }
 703: 
 704:     private static string SanitizeFileName(string sheetNumber)
 705:     {
 706:         var invalid = Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars().ToHashSet();
 707:         var cleaned = new string(sheetNumber.Trim()
 708:             .Select(ch => invalid.Contains(ch) ? '-' : ch)
 709:             .ToArray());
 710:         cleaned = Regex.Replace(cleaned, @"\s+", "-");
 711:         cleaned = Regex.Replace(cleaned, "-{2,}", "-").Trim('-', '.');
 712:         return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cleaned) ? "sheet" : cleaned;
 713:     }
 714: 
 715:     private static bool IsBridgeUnavailable(Exception ex)
 716:         => ex is TimeoutException
 717:            || ex is IOException
 718:            || ex is UnauthorizedAccessException
 719:            || ex is InvalidOperationException invalid
 720:               && (invalid.Message.Contains("Could not queue Drafter bridge command", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 721:                   || invalid.Message.Contains("no active Revit document", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 722: 
 723:     private static SheetComposerOccupiedDetail? ResolveOccupiedPlacement(
 724:         SheetComposerPlacement placement,
 725:         IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SheetComposerOccupiedDetail> occupied)
 726:     {
 727:         if (occupied.TryGetValue(NormalizeDetailNumber(placement.DetailNumber), out var byNumber))
 728:         {
 729:             return byNumber;
 730:         }
 731: 
 732:         return occupied.Values.FirstOrDefault(x => string.Equals(x.ViewName, placement.CanonicalViewName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
 733:     }
 734: 
 735:     // View Prefix ("KOR-D-#####") read over getparams, the same reader MasterPublisher uses.
 736:     // If one view is omitted from an otherwise valid reply, the view-name fallback and Revit's
 737:     // one-sheet rule still catch duplicate placement.
 738:     private async Task<IReadOnlyDictionary<long, string>> GetViewPrefixesAsync(IEnumerable<long> viewIds, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 739:     {
 740:         var prefixes = new Dictionary<long, string>();
 741:         var batch = new List<long>(ParameterBatchSize);
 742:         foreach (var id in viewIds)
 743:         {
 744:             batch.Add(id);
 745:             if (batch.Count == ParameterBatchSize)
 746:             {
 747:                 await ReadPrefixBatchAsync(batch, prefixes, bridgeTimeout);
 748:                 batch.Clear();
 749:             }
 750:         }
 751: 
 752:         if (batch.Count > 0)
 753:         {
 754:             await ReadPrefixBatchAsync(batch, prefixes, bridgeTimeout);
 755:         }
 756: 
 757:         return prefixes;
 758:     }
 759: 
 760:     private async Task ReadPrefixBatchAsync(IReadOnlyList<long> ids, IDictionary<long, string> prefixes, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 761:     {
 762:         if (ids.Count == 0)
 763:         {
 764:             return;
 765:         }
 766: 
 767:         var reply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new { verb = "getparams", ids = ids.ToArray() }, bridgeTimeout);
 768:         foreach (var item in EnumerateResultItems(reply.Result, "elements", "items", "results"))
 769:         {
 770:             if (TryGetInt64(item, "id", out var id) && TryReadViewPrefix(item, out var prefix))
 771:             {
 772:                 prefixes[id] = prefix;
 773:             }
 774:         }
 775:     }
 776: 
 777:     private static bool TryReadViewPrefix(JsonElement item, out string prefix)
 778:     {
 779:         prefix = "";
 780:         if (!TryGetProperty(item, "parameters", out var parameters) || parameters.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
 781:         {
 782:             return false;
 783:         }
 784: 
 785:         foreach (var parameter in parameters.EnumerateArray())
 786:         {

 873:     {

 875:         {
 876:             foreach (var property in element.EnumerateObject())
 877:             {

 879:                 {
 880:                     value = property.Value;

 882:                 }
 883:             }
 884:         }
 885: 
 886:         value = default;

 895:     private static bool TryGetInt64(JsonElement element, string name, out long value)
 896:     {
 897:         value = 0;

 899:         {
 900:             return false;
 901:         }
 902: 
 903:         if (property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number && property.TryGetInt64(out value))
 904:         {
 905:             return true;
 906:         }
 907: 
 908:         return property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
 909:                && long.TryParse(property.GetString(), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out value);

 924:

 926:                && int.TryParse(property.GetString(), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out value);
 927:     }

 929:     private static bool TryGetBool(JsonElement element, string name, out bool value)
 930:     {
 931:         value = false;
 932:         if (!TryGetProperty(element, name, out var property))
 933:         {
 934:             return false;
 935:         }
 936: 
 937:         return property.ValueKind switch
 938:         {
 939:             JsonValueKind.True => SetBool(out value, true),
 940:             JsonValueKind.False => SetBool(out value, false),
 941:             JsonValueKind.String when bool.TryParse(property.GetString(), out var parsed) => SetBool(out value, parsed),
 942:             _ => false
 943:         };
 944:     }

 946:     private static bool SetBool(out bool value, bool parsed)
 947:     {
 948:         value = parsed;
 949:         return true;

 963:         }
 964:

 966:                && double.TryParse(property.GetString(), NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out value);

 450:             {
 451:                 throw new InvalidOperationException("BridgeRoot must use an admin-share root like \\\\host\\C$ when MASTER uses a Revit-host local drive path.");
 452:             }
 453: 
 454:             return fullPath;
 455:         }
 456: 
 457:         if (!char.Equals(char.ToUpperInvariant(fullPath[0]), driveLetter))
 458:         {
 459:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"MASTER path '{fullPath}' is on drive {char.ToUpperInvariant(fullPath[0])}: but BridgeRoot maps drive {driveLetter}:.");
 460:         }
 461: 
 462:         var relativePath = fullPath[3..];
 463:         return $@"\\{host}\{driveLetter}$\{relativePath}";
 464:     }

 466:     private static bool IsLocalDrivePath(string path)
 467:         => path.Length >= 3
 468:            && path[1] == ':'
 469:            && (path[2] == Path.DirectorySeparatorChar || path[2] == Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar)
 470:            && char.IsLetter(path[0]);

 472:     private bool TryGetBridgeDriveShare(out string host, out char driveLetter)
 473:     {
 474:         host = "";
 475:         driveLetter = '\0';
 476: 
 477:         var root = Path.GetPathRoot(_options.BridgeRoot);
 478:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(root) || !root.StartsWith(@"\\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
 479:         {
 480:             return false;
 481:         }
 482: 
 483:         var parts = root.Trim('\\').Split('\\', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
 484:         if (parts.Length < 2 || parts[1].Length != 2 || parts[1][1] != '$' || !char.IsLetter(parts[1][0]))
 485:         {
 486:             return false;
 487:         }
 488: 
 489:         host = parts[0];
 490:         driveLetter = char.ToUpperInvariant(parts[1][0]);
 491:         return true;
 492:     }

 494:     private async Task<IReadOnlyList<BridgeView>> QueryViewsAsync(TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)

 497:         {

 499:             kind = "views"

 501: 
 502:         var views = new List<BridgeView>();

 506:             {

 513: 
 514:         if (views.Count == 0)

 517:         }
 518:

 522:     private async Task<IReadOnlyDictionary<long, string>> GetViewPrefixesAsync(IEnumerable<long> viewIds, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 523:     {
 524:         var prefixes = new Dictionary<long, string>();
 525:         var batch = new List<long>(ParameterBatchSize);
 526: 
 527:         foreach (var id in viewIds)
 528:         {
 529:             batch.Add(id);
 530:             if (batch.Count == ParameterBatchSize)
 531:             {
 532:                 await ReadPrefixBatchAsync(batch, prefixes, bridgeTimeout);
 533:                 batch.Clear();
 534:             }
 535:         }
 536: 
 537:         if (batch.Count > 0)
 538:         {
 539:             await ReadPrefixBatchAsync(batch, prefixes, bridgeTimeout);
 540:         }
 541: 
 542:         return prefixes;
 543:     }

 545:     private async Task ReadPrefixBatchAsync(IReadOnlyList<long> ids, IDictionary<long, string> prefixes, TimeSpan bridgeTimeout)
 546:     {
 547:         var reply = await _bridge.SendAsync(new
 548:         {
 549:             verb = "getparams",
 550:             ids = ids.ToArray()
 551:         }, bridgeTimeout);
 552: 
 553:         var expected = ids.ToHashSet();
 554:         var seen = new HashSet<long>();
 555:         foreach (var item in EnumerateResultItems(reply.Result, "elements", "items", "results"))
 556:         {
 557:             if (!TryGetInt64(item, "id", out var id))
 558:             {
 559:                 continue;
 560:             }
 561: 
 562:             seen.Add(id);
 563:             // A view with no (or empty) "View Prefix" is a legitimate NON-detail and must be KEPT:
 564:             // verified live that schedules and sheets carry no View Prefix parameter, and 3D/plan
 565:             // views carry it empty. Only a KOR-D-##### prefix marks a detail. Do NOT throw here —
 566:             // that broke every publish on the first schedule. The real unverifiable case (a requested
 567:             // view DROPPED entirely from the reply) is the missing-id check below.
 568:             if (TryReadViewPrefix(item, out var prefix))
 569:             {
 570:                 prefixes[id] = prefix;
 571:             }
 572:         }
 573: 
 574:         var missing = expected
 575:             .Where(x => !seen.Contains(x))
 576:             .Take(10)
 577:             .ToList();
 578:         if (missing.Count > 0)
 579:         {
 580:             throw new InvalidOperationException($"Drafter bridge getparams omitted {missing.Count} requested view(s): {string.Join(", ", missing)}.");
 581:         }
 582:     }

 584:     private static IReadOnlyList<MasterPublishRemovedView> BuildDetailViews(
 585:         IReadOnlyList<BridgeView> views,
 586:         IReadOnlyDictionary<long, string> prefixes)
 587:     {
 588:         var viewNames = views.ToDictionary(x => x.Id, x => x.Name);
 589:         return prefixes
 590:             .Where(x => DetailPrefixPattern.IsMatch(x.Value))
 591:             .Select(x => new MasterPublishRemovedView(
 592:                 x.Key,
 593:                 x.Value.ToUpperInvariant(),
 594:                 viewNames.TryGetValue(x.Key, out var name) ? name : ""))
 595:             .ToList();
 596:     }

 598:     private static IEnumerable<IReadOnlyList<T>> Batch<T>(IReadOnlyList<T> items, int size)
 599:     {
 600:         for (var index = 0; index < items.Count; index += size)
 601:         {
 602:             yield return items.Skip(index).Take(Math.Min(size, items.Count - index)).ToList();
 603:         }
 604:     }

 606:     private static bool TryResolveExportedViewPdf(
 607:         JsonElement result,
 608:         long viewElementId,
 609:         string detailNumber,
 610:         bool allowTopLevelPdf,
 611:         out string pdf,
 612:         out string error)
 613:     {
 614:         pdf = "";
 615:         error = "";
 616: 
 617:         if (TryFindViewExportItem(result, viewElementId, detailNumber, out var item))
 618:         {
 619:             if (TryGetBool(item, "exists", out var itemExists) && !itemExists)
 620:             {
 621:                 error = "Drafter did not export the view.";
 622:                 return false;
 623:             }
 624: 
 625:             if (TryGetString(item, "pdf") is { Length: > 0 } itemPdf)
 626:             {
 627:                 pdf = itemPdf;
 628:                 return true;
 629:             }
 630:         }
 631: 
 632:         if (allowTopLevelPdf && TryGetString(result, "pdf") is { Length: > 0 } resultPdf)
 633:         {
 634:             pdf = resultPdf;
 635:             return true;
 636:         }
 637: 
 638:         error = "Drafter export did not return a PDF path.";
 639:         return false;
 640:     }

 642:     private static bool TryFindViewExportItem(JsonElement result, long viewElementId, string detailNumber, out JsonElement item)
 643:     {
 644:         item = default;
 645:         var fallback = default(JsonElement);
 646:         var count = 0;
 647:         foreach (var candidate in EnumerateResultItems(result, "views", "items", "results"))
 648:         {
 649:             count++;
 650:             fallback = candidate;
 651:             if ((TryGetInt64(candidate, "id", out var id) && id == viewElementId)
 652:                 || string.Equals(TryGetString(candidate, "key"), detailNumber, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 653:                 || string.Equals(TryGetString(candidate, "detailNumber"), detailNumber, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 654:             {
 655:                 item = candidate;
 656:                 return true;
 657:             }
 658:         }
 659: 
 660:         if (count == 1)
 661:         {
 662:             item = fallback;
 663:             return true;
 664:         }
 665: 
 666:         return false;
 667:     }

 669:     private static bool TryGetBool(JsonElement element, string name, out bool value)
 670:     {
 671:         value = false;
 672:         if (!TryGetProperty(element, name, out var property))
 673:         {
 674:             return false;
 675:         }
 676: 
 677:         if (property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True || property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.False)
 678:         {
 679:             value = property.GetBoolean();
 680:             return true;
 681:         }
 682: 
 683:         return property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String && bool.TryParse(property.GetString(), out value);
 684:     }
 685: 
 686:     private static bool TryReadViewPrefix(JsonElement item, out string prefix)
 687:     {
 688:         prefix = "";
 689:         if (!TryGetProperty(item, "parameters", out var parameters))
 690:         {
 691:             return false;
 692:         }
 693: 
 694:         if (parameters.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
 695:         {
 696:             foreach (var parameter in parameters.EnumerateArray())
 697:             {
 698:                 var name = TryGetString(parameter, "name");
 699:                 if (!string.Equals(name, "View Prefix", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 700:                 {
 701:                     continue;
 702:                 }
 703: 
 704:                 prefix = TryGetString(parameter, "displayValue")
 705:                     ?? TryGetString(parameter, "display")
 706:                     ?? TryGetString(parameter, "value")
 707:                     ?? TryGetString(parameter, "stringValue")
 708:                     ?? "";
 709:                 prefix = prefix.Trim();
 710:                 return true;
 711:             }
 712:         }
 713:         else if (parameters.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && TryGetProperty(parameters, "View Prefix", out var value))
 714:         {
 715:             prefix = ReadScalarOrDisplayValue(value).Trim();
 716:             return true;
 717:         }
 718: 
 719:         return false;
 720:     }
 721: 
 722:     private static string ReadScalarOrDisplayValue(JsonElement value)
 723:     {
 724:         if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String)
 725:         {
 726:             return value.GetString() ?? "";
 727:         }
 728: 
 729:         if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
 730:         {
 731:             return TryGetString(value, "displayValue")
 732:                 ?? TryGetString(value, "display")
 733:                 ?? TryGetString(value, "value")
 734:                 ?? TryGetString(value, "stringValue")
 735:                 ?? "";
 736:         }
 737: 
 738:         return "";
 739:     }
 740: 
 741:     private static IEnumerable<JsonElement> EnumerateResultItems(JsonElement result, params string[] arrayPropertyNames)
 742:     {
 743:         if (result.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
 744:         {
 745:             foreach (var item in result.EnumerateArray())
 746:             {
 747:                 yield return item;
 748:             }
 749: 
 750:             yield break;
 751:         }
 752: 
 753:         if (result.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
 754:         {
 755:             yield break;
 756:         }
 757: 
 758:         foreach (var propertyName in arrayPropertyNames)
 759:         {
 760:             if (!TryGetProperty(result, propertyName, out var array) || array.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Array)
 761:             {
 762:                 continue;
 763:             }
 764: 
 765:             foreach (var item in array.EnumerateArray())
 766:             {
 767:                 yield return item;
 768:             }
 769: 
 770:             yield break;
 771:         }
 772:     }
 773: 
 774:     private static bool TryGetProperty(JsonElement element, string name, out JsonElement value)
 775:     {
 776:         if (element.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
 777:         {
 778:             foreach (var property in element.EnumerateObject())
 779:             {
 780:                 if (string.Equals(property.Name, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 781:                 {
 782:                     value = property.Value;
 783:                     return true;
 784:                 }
 785:             }
 786:         }
 787: 
 788:         value = default;
 789:         return false;
 790:     }
 791: 
 792:     private static string? TryGetString(JsonElement element, string name)
 793:         => TryGetProperty(element, name, out var value) && value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
 794:             ? value.GetString()
 795:             : null;
 796: 
 797:     private static bool TryGetInt64(JsonElement element, string name, out long value)
 798:     {
 799:         value = 0;
 800:         if (!TryGetProperty(element, name, out var property))
 801:         {
 802:             return false;
 803:         }
 804: 
 805:         if (property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number && property.TryGetInt64(out value))
 806:         {
 807:             return true;
 808:         }
 809: 
 810:         return property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String && long.TryParse(property.GetString(), out value);
 811:     }

 814: }

 279: 
 280:         _documentSnapshot = data.Select(r => new DocumentRow
 281:         {
 282:             DocumentId = r.DocumentId,
 283:             Title = r.Title,
 284:             DetailNumber = r.DetailNumber ?? string.Empty,
 285:             GroupName = r.GroupName,
 286:             CurrentOfficialText = r.CurrentOfficialText,
 287:             LatestStatusText = ToStatusText(r.LatestStatus)
 288:         }).ToList();
 289:         _versionSnapshot = new List<VersionRow>();
 290:         UpdateHeroMetrics();
 291:         ApplyDocumentsItemsSource();
 292:         VersionsGrid.ItemsSource = null;
 293:         UpdateSelectionSummary();
 294:     }

 296:     private async Task LoadVersionsUiAsync(long documentId)
 297:     {
 298:         if (_repo == null)
 299:             return;
 300: 
 301:         _versionSnapshot = (await _repo.LoadVersionsAsync(documentId)).Select(r => new VersionRow
 302:         {
 303:             DocumentVersionId = r.DocumentVersionId,
 304:             DocumentId = r.DocumentId,
 305:             DocumentVariantId = r.DocumentVariantId,
 306:             VariantKey = r.VariantKey,
 307:             VersionNumber = r.VersionNumber,
 308:             VersionLabel = $"v{r.VersionNumber}",
 309:             Status = r.Status,
 310:             StatusText = ToStatusText(r.Status),
 311:             IsCurrentOfficial = r.IsCurrentOfficial,
 312:             CreatedUtc = r.CreatedUtc,
 313:             CreatedUtcDisplay = r.CreatedUtc.ToString("u"),
 314:             OriginalFileName = r.OriginalFileName,
 315:             FileSizeKb = Math.Round(r.ContentLengthBytes / 1024.0, 1),
 316:             StoragePath = r.StoragePath,
 317:             RowVersion = r.RowVersion
 318:         }).ToList();
 319:         UpdateHeroMetrics();
 320:         VersionsGrid.ItemsSource = _versionSnapshot;
 321:         ApplyVersionSummaryToSelectedDocument(_versionSnapshot);
 322:         UpdateActionStates();
 323:     }

 325:     private void ApplyVersionSummaryToSelectedDocument(IReadOnlyList<VersionRow> versions)
 326:     {

 332:             ? "(per variant)"
 333:             : versions.FirstOrDefault(x => x.IsCurrentOfficial)?.VersionLabel ?? "None";

 410:     // Tools ▸ Sync Part Images: reads every Quick Insert thumbnail (fastener/bolt .png + QuickPick .bmp)
 411:     // and upserts it into the DB art store the app shows. Production Quick Insert reads the files, not the
 412:     // store, so this never touches production — it just refreshes what reviewers see.
 413:     private async void SyncPartImages_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
 414:     {
 415:         if (!EnsureCanPublishAction()) return;
 416:         if (_korStandardsRepo == null || _promoterRepo == null)
 417:         {
 418:             MessageBox.Show(this, "KorStandards is not fully configured (reader + promoter required).", "Standard Details — Sync Part Images", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
 419:             return;
 420:         }
 421:         if (MessageBox.Show(this, "Re-sync all Quick Insert part thumbnails into the image store?" + Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine + "Reads the current thumbnails and refreshes the DB store the app shows. Production Quick Insert is not affected.", "Standard Details — Sync Part Images", MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, MessageBoxImage.Question) != MessageBoxResult.OK) return;
 422: 
 423:         SetActivityMessage("Syncing part images...", BannerTone.Info);
 424:         ToolsButton.IsEnabled = false;
 425:         try
 426:         {
 427:             var (total, done, missing, failed) = await Task.Run(SyncPartImagesCoreAsync);
 428:             SetActivityMessage($"Part images synced: {done} updated, {missing} missing, {failed} failed (of {total}).", failed > 0 ? BannerTone.Warning : BannerTone.Success);
 429:             if (_partsMode) await LoadDocumentsUiAsync();
 430:         }
 431:         catch (Exception ex)
 432:         {
 433:             SetActivityMessage("Part image sync failed.", BannerTone.Error);
 434:             Log.Warning(ex, "Standard Details: part image sync failed.");
 435:             MessageBox.Show(this, ex.Message, "Standard Details — Sync Part Images Failed", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
 436:         }
 437:         finally
 438:         {
 439:             ToolsButton.IsEnabled = true;
 440:         }
 441:     }
 442: 
 443:     private async Task<(int total, int done, int missing, int failed)> SyncPartImagesCoreAsync()
 444:     {
 445:         var root = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_partImageRoot) ? @"\\Kor-fs01\Drafting\2026\QuickPick\BMP" : _partImageRoot;
 446:         var refs = await _korStandardsRepo!.LoadComponentImageRefsAsync();
 447:         int done = 0, missing = 0, failed = 0;
 448:         foreach (var cr in refs)
 449:         {
 450:             try
 451:             {
 452:                 var path = System.IO.Path.IsPathRooted(cr.ImageFile) ? cr.ImageFile : System.IO.Path.Combine(root, cr.ImageFile);
 453:                 if (!System.IO.File.Exists(path)) { missing++; continue; }
 454:                 var (png, w, h) = LoadImageAsPng(path);
 455:                 if (png.Length == 0) { failed++; continue; }
 456:                 var (ok, _) = await _promoterRepo!.SetRenderedImageAsync("component", $"{cr.FamilyName}|{cr.TypeName}", png, w, h, "sync-thumb");
 457:                 if (ok) done++; else failed++;
 458:             }
 459:             catch (Exception ex)
 460:             {
 461:                 failed++;
 462:                 Log.Warning(ex, "Standard Details: sync image failed for {Family}/{Type}.", cr.FamilyName, cr.TypeName);
 463:             }
 464:         }
 465:         return (refs.Count, done, missing, failed);
 466:     }
 467: 
 468:     // Loads any WPF-decodable image (BMP/PNG/…) and re-encodes it as PNG bytes for the store.
 469:     private static (byte[] png, int w, int h) LoadImageAsPng(string path)
 470:     {
 471:         var bytes = System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes(path);
 472:         using var ms = new System.IO.MemoryStream(bytes);
 473:         var decoder = System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapDecoder.Create(ms, System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCreateOptions.None, System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad);
 474:         var frame = decoder.Frames[0];
 475:         var encoder = new System.Windows.Media.Imaging.PngBitmapEncoder();
 476:         encoder.Frames.Add(System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapFrame.Create(frame));
 477:         using var outMs = new System.IO.MemoryStream();
 478:         encoder.Save(outMs);
 479:         return (outMs.ToArray(), frame.PixelWidth, frame.PixelHeight);
 480:     }

 482:     // Parts ride the same confidence ladder as details, so the same status vocabulary applies.
 483:     private static string PartStatusLabel(QuickInsertPartRow p)
 484:     {
 485:         if (string.Equals(p.Confidence, "rejected", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "Rejected";
 486:         if (p.IsPlaceable) return "Approved";
 487:         if (string.Equals(p.Confidence, "content-verified", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 488:             || string.Equals(p.Confidence, "human-confirmed", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "Held";
 489:         return "Pending";
 490:     }
 491: 
 492:     private static string StatusWord(string label) => label switch
 493:     {
 494:         "Approved" => "Approved",
 495:         "Pending" => "Pending",
 496:         "Held" => "On hold",
 497:         "Rejected" => "Rejected",
 498:         _ => label
 499:     };

 739:         SetActivityMessage("Publishing approved details to MASTER...", BannerTone.Info);
 740: 
 741:         try
 742:         {

 744:             var publisher = new MasterPublisher(
 745:                 bridge,
 746:                 _korStandardsRepo,
 747:                 options,
 748:                 _promoterRepo,
 749:                 message => Dispatcher.Invoke(() => SetActivityMessage(message, BannerTone.Info)));
 750:             var result = await publisher.PublishAsync(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15));
 751:             var summary = BuildMasterPublishSummary(result);
 752: 
 753:             SetActivityMessage($"Published MASTER: verified {result.MasterDetailCount} detail view(s); captured {result.PdfCapture.CapturedCount}/{result.PdfCapture.TargetCount} PDF(s).", BannerTone.Success);
 754:             MessageBox.Show(this, summary, "Standard Details - Publish to Master", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information);
 755:         }
 756:         catch (Exception ex)
 757:         {
 758:             SetActivityMessage("Publish to MASTER failed. Review the error before retrying.", BannerTone.Error);
 759:             Log.Warning(ex, "Standard Details: publish to MASTER failed.");
 760:             MessageBox.Show(this, ex.Message, "Standard Details - Publish to Master Failed", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
 761:         }
 762:         finally
 763:         {
 764:             UpdateActionStates();
 765:         }

 768:     private static string BuildMasterPublishSummary(MasterPublishResult result)
 769:     {
 770:         var text = new StringBuilder();
 771:         text.AppendLine("MASTER publish completed.");
 772:         text.AppendLine();
 773:         text.AppendLine($"Approved details: {result.ApprovedCount}");
 774:         text.AppendLine($"AUTHORING KOR-D views: {result.AuthoringDetailCount}");
 775:         text.AppendLine($"Removed non-approved KOR-D views: {result.RemovedViews.Count}");
 776:         text.AppendLine($"MASTER KOR-D views after verification: {result.MasterDetailCount}");
 777:         text.AppendLine($"Verified: {result.Verified}");
 778:         text.AppendLine($"PDFs captured: {result.PdfCapture.CapturedCount} of {result.PdfCapture.TargetCount}");
 779:         text.AppendLine($"PDFs skipped: {result.PdfCapture.SkippedCount}");
 780:         text.AppendLine($"PDF capture failures: {result.PdfCapture.FailedCount}");
 781: 
 782:         if (result.RemovedViews.Count > 0)
 783:         {
 784:             text.AppendLine();
 785:             text.AppendLine("Removed:");
 786:             foreach (var view in result.RemovedViews.Take(20))
 787:             {
 788:                 text.AppendLine($"- {view.DetailNumber} ({view.ViewId}) {view.ViewName}");
 789:             }
 790: 
 791:             if (result.RemovedViews.Count > 20)
 792:             {
 793:                 text.AppendLine($"- ... {result.RemovedViews.Count - 20} more");
 794:             }
 795:         }
 796: 
 797:         if (result.ApprovedMissingFromAuthoring.Count > 0)
 798:         {
 799:             text.AppendLine();
 800:             text.AppendLine("Approved but not found in AUTHORING:");
 801:             foreach (var detailNumber in result.ApprovedMissingFromAuthoring.Take(20))
 802:             {
 803:                 text.AppendLine($"- {detailNumber}");
 804:             }
 805: 
 806:             if (result.ApprovedMissingFromAuthoring.Count > 20)
 807:             {
 808:                 text.AppendLine($"- ... {result.ApprovedMissingFromAuthoring.Count - 20} more");
 809:             }
 810:         }
 811: 
 812:         if (result.PdfCapture.Failures.Count > 0)
 813:         {
 814:             text.AppendLine();
 815:             text.AppendLine("PDF capture issues:");
 816:             foreach (var failure in result.PdfCapture.Failures.Take(20))
 817:             {
 818:                 text.AppendLine($"- {failure}");
 819:             }
 820: 
 821:             if (result.PdfCapture.Failures.Count > 20)
 822:             {
 823:                 text.AppendLine($"- ... {result.PdfCapture.Failures.Count - 20} more");
 824:             }
 825:         }
 826: 
 827:         return text.ToString();
 828:     }

1125:     private async Task DecideSelectedVersionAsync(byte targetStatus, int decision)
1126:     {
1127:         if (VersionsGrid.SelectedItem is not VersionRow v) { SetActivityMessage("Select a revision first.", BannerTone.Info); MessageBox.Show(this, "Select a version first.", "Standard Details — Approval", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Information); return; }
1128:         if (_repo == null) return;
1129:         StandardDetailsStateChangeResult result;
1130:         try
1131:         {
1132:             result = await _repo.DecideAsync(v.DocumentVersionId, v.DocumentId, v.RowVersion, _actorUserId, Environment.UserName, targetStatus, decision);
1133:             if (result.RowsAffected == 0) { await HandleStateChangeFailureAsync(v.DocumentId, result, StatusSubmitted, "Approval", "Approve/Reject requires Submitted status.", "Approve/Reject is only available when status is Submitted."); return; }
1134:         }
1135:         catch (SqlException ex)
1136:         {
1137:             SetActivityMessage("Approval failed. No changes were committed.", BannerTone.Error);
1138:             Log.Warning(ex, "Standard Details: approval decision failed for document version {DocumentVersionId}.", v.DocumentVersionId);
1139:             MessageBox.Show(this, "Approval failed. No changes were committed.", "Standard Details - Approval", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
1140:             return;
1141:         }
1142:         catch (Exception ex)
1143:         {
1144:             SetActivityMessage("Approval failed. No changes were committed.", BannerTone.Error);
1145:             Log.Warning(ex, "Standard Details: approval decision failed for document version {DocumentVersionId}.", v.DocumentVersionId);
1146:             MessageBox.Show(this, "Approval failed. No changes were committed.", "Standard Details - Approval", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
1147:             return;
1148:         }
1149: 
1150:         await LoadVersionsUiAsync(v.DocumentId);
1151:         if (decision != 1)
1152:         {
1153:             SetActivityMessage("Revision rejected.", BannerTone.Success);
1154:             return;
1155:         }
1156: 
1157:         try
1158:         {
1159:             var promotionSummary = await ProcessPendingPromotionsAsync();
1160:             var tone = promotionSummary.Contains("failed", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || promotionSummary.Contains("not configured", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
1161:                 ? BannerTone.Warning
1162:                 : BannerTone.Success;
1163:             SetActivityMessage($"Revision approved. {promotionSummary}", tone);
1164:         }
1165:         catch (Exception ex)
1166:         {
1167:             SetActivityMessage("Revision approved, but promotion processing failed. Review the Promotion Queue.", BannerTone.Warning);
1168:             Log.Warning(ex, "Standard Details: promotion processing failed after approval.");
1169:         }
1170:     }
